clusters.pick_reason: #2215 fixes an actual behavioral bug, not just cosmetics: shouldAttemptFallback's root-path short-circuit compares the normalized pathname to '/', but stripping a trailing slash from '/' always yields '', so that check could never match and root-like paths triggered a redundant extra fallback request — #2215 corrects the comparison to '' and centralizes the stripping logic in a reusable normalizeDiscoveryPath() helper. #2214 applies the same regex-based multi-slash strip (fixing the cosmetic double-slash case, e.g. '/foo//.well-known/...') in two call sites but never touches shouldAttemptFallback, so the redundant-fallback bug remains after #2214 merges alone. #2215's fix should be reconciled with #2214's second call site (buildDiscoveryUrls) to ensure multi-trailing-slash inputs are covered everywhere.

clusters.pick_reason: Both PRs make close() settle parked JSON-mode POST responses instead of leaving them open, so only one can land without a merge conflict on the same close() method. #2600's diff is broader: it also fixes that close() never cleared _requestToStreamMapping (a correlation-map leak that persists for the process lifetime) and adds a re-check in send() for the case where storeEvent()'s await straddles a close() call, neither of which #2692 addresses. #2600's changeset also explicitly calls out that the fix applies to NodeStreamableHTTPServerTransport as well. #2692's specific error-shape choice (JSON-RPC -32000 'Connection closed', grouped by stream for batched POSTs, preserving an already-produced real response instead of overwriting it) is a genuine improvement over #2600's plain 404 'Session not found' and should be folded into #2600 during follow-up review before merge.
